name: hexaemeron
description: Receipted delivery through merge and closure, with ranked frontier, audit, fuzzing and prose tools.

interface.shortDescription: Receipted delivery through merge and closure, with ranked frontier, audit, fuzzing and prose tools.
interface.longDescription: Takes a topic from nothing to a working prototype through a receipt-backed controller: a linted study, a runbook of discrete steps, then per step the simplest satisfying implementation, a security loop over the vendored Pashov suite, a prose pass through Imprimatur and Vulgate, and a merged pull request with its task issue closed. Kronos can rank eligible held frontiers and repeat complete Fiat runs until no worthwhile frontier remains.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $hexaemeron:fiat to start "<topic>" in the current repository without creating GitHub issues. If existing controller state is complete, archive and reset it automatically before starting.
